definitions.explanation: The tabular arrangement of chemical elements organized by atomic number, showing periodic trends in their properties.

examples.japanese: {周期表|しゅうきひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
{周期表|しゅうきひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{元素|げんそ}→元素：09662_genso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the element's position on the periodic table.

examples.japanese: ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{周期表|しゅうきひょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}い→習う：00479_narau⟧、⟦{元素|げんそ}→元素：09662_genso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性質|せいしつ}→性質：01638_seishitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規則性|きそくせい}→規則性：15247_kisokusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: In chemistry class, we learned how to read the periodic table and studied the patterns in element properties.

notes:
The standard term for the periodic table of elements. Composed of ⟦{周期|しゅうき}→周期：21707_shuuki⟧ (period, cycle) + ⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ (table, chart). A fundamental concept in chemistry education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {周期表|しゅうきひょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{元素|げんそ}→元素：09662_genso⟧: elements on the periodic table
- {周期表|しゅうきひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暗記|あんき}→暗記：01701_anki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to memorize the periodic table
- {周期表|しゅうきひょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{族|ぞく}: groups on the periodic table
- {周期表|しゅうきひょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周期|しゅうき}→周期：21707_shuuki⟧: periods on the periodic table

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{元素|げんそ}→元素：09662_genso⟧: element
- {原子番号|げんしばんごう}: atomic number
- {化学記号|かがくきごう}: chemical symbol
- {周期律|しゅうきりつ}: periodic law

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese students commonly memorize the periodic table using mnemonics based on the Japanese readings of element names. The phrase "{水兵|すいへい}リーベ⟦{僕|ぼく}→僕：01729_boku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧" (H, He, Li, Be, B, C, N, O, F, Ne) is one of the most famous.
